LEGAL_PAGE.TITLE: Privacy Policy
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_1_LI_1: Account information: name, email, clinic name, optional profile photo.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_1_LI_2: Patient records entered by your clinic: intake forms, session notes, session audio, and generated reports.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_1_LI_3: Usage data: how the platform is used, for support and reliability purposes.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_2_P_1: Patient and session data is used to operate the service for your clinic: generating reports, transcribing sessions, and enabling search across your own patients' history through the query agent.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_2_P_2: Separately, and only in anonymized, aggregated form, session data helps us improve how the system structures and retrieves information — for example, refining how session text is segmented for accurate search. This analysis does not identify individual patients, and identifiable patient records are never used to train AI models.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_3_P: Data is stored in encrypted infrastructure, with session data indexed for semantic search to support the query agent. Access to a clinic's patient records is restricted to that clinic's authorized doctors and staff.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_4_P: Some processing, such as speech-to-text transcription and AI-assisted drafting, is performed by third-party AI providers. These providers process data solely to perform the requested task and are not authorized to use it for their own purposes.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_5_P: Patient and session data is retained for as long as your clinic's account is active, so you can access historical records. You may request deletion of your clinic's data by contacting us.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_6_P: Depending on your jurisdiction, you and your patients may have rights to access, correct, or request deletion of personal data. Clinics are responsible for handling patient-facing privacy requests; contact us for assistance with data stored on PhysioAssist.
LEGAL_PAGE.SECTION_7_P: Privacy questions can be sent to privacy@physioassist.app.
LEGAL_PAGE.DISCLAIMER: This document is a working draft for demonstration purposes and has not been reviewed by a lawyer. Review with legal counsel before production use.

TERMS_PAGE.TITLE: Terms of Service
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_1_P: These Terms govern use of PhysioAssist by physiotherapy clinics, doctors, and staff accounts ("you") who register a clinic on the platform. By creating an account you confirm you are authorized to register your clinic and to accept these Terms on its behalf.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_2_P_1: The free plan is provided so clinics can evaluate PhysioAssist with real patients before committing to a paid plan. It includes the following limits:
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_2_LI_1: Session audio recordings are limited to 1 minute per session.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_2_LI_2: Up to 10 active patients per clinic.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_2_P_2: Paid plans remove these limits and unlock additional capabilities as they become available, including longer session recordings and AI-assisted recommendations.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_3_P_1: Session and patient data you enter is stored to provide the service to your clinic: generating reports, transcribing sessions, and allowing you to search your own patients' records.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_3_P_2: We also use patient data, in anonymized and aggregated form only, to improve how the system organizes and retrieves information internally (for example, how session text is broken into segments for search). This process does not identify individual patients, and no individually identifiable patient data is used to train any AI model.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_4_P: You are responsible for obtaining any consent required from your patients for their information to be processed through PhysioAssist, in accordance with applicable data protection law in your jurisdiction. You should inform patients that their clinical records are stored and processed digitally, including through AI-assisted tools.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_5_P: Each clinic's data is only accessible to that clinic's registered doctors and staff. We do not share patient-identifiable data with other clinics or third parties outside of the service providers necessary to operate PhysioAssist (e.g. hosting and AI processing providers).
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_6_P: We may update these Terms as the product evolves, particularly as new paid features are introduced. Continued use of PhysioAssist after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
TERMS_PAGE.SECTION_7_P: Questions about these Terms can be sent to support@physioassist.app.

SLOT_MATCHING_PREFERENCES.TITLE: Slot matching
SLOT_MATCHING_PREFERENCES.SUBTITLE: These control which free slots get offered to patients when booking against your calendar.
SLOT_MATCHING_PREFERENCES.ALLOW_SHORTER_TITLE: Suggest shorter appointments when there's no perfect match
SLOT_MATCHING_PREFERENCES.ALLOW_SHORTER_DESC: If a patient asks for, say, a 60-minute session and your calendar only has a 45-minute gap, turning this on lets the system offer that shorter opening instead of nothing. Turn it off to only show patients times that match exactly what they asked for.
SLOT_MATCHING_PREFERENCES.TOLERANCE_DESC: How much shorter than requested a slot can be and still get offered — e.g. 15 minutes lets a 45-minute opening stand in for a 60-minute request.
SLOT_MATCHING_PREFERENCES.DAYS_OUT_DESC: Beyond this many days out, stop holding out for an exact-length slot and start surfacing near-miss shorter slots instead.
